modifiers.name: Berserker
modifiers.summary: The boss gets stronger at set health thresholds.

modifiers.name: Chicken Summoning
modifiers.summary: Summons shadow chickens when it spots you. They vanish after 30 seconds and give no kill credit.

modifiers.name: Cloning
modifiers.summary: Splits off a clone of itself when damaged. Clones vanish after 30 seconds and give no kill credit.

modifiers.name: Cool Steppin
modifiers.summary: Keeps turning patches of floor to ice.

modifiers.name: Ensnaring
modifiers.summary: Its hits snare you and knock you off your mount.

modifiers.name: Furious
modifiers.summary: Gets stronger each time one of its allies is killed.

modifiers.name: Furiously Unbridled
modifiers.summary: Gets stronger and heals each time one of its allies is killed. The bonus stacks.

modifiers.name: Hardened I
modifiers.summary: Incoming damage −15%.

modifiers.name: Hardened II
modifiers.summary: Incoming damage −30%.

modifiers.name: Hardened III
modifiers.summary: Incoming damage −45%.

modifiers.name: Hardened IV
modifiers.summary: Incoming damage −60%.

modifiers.name: Hardened V
modifiers.summary: Incoming damage −75%.

modifiers.name: Icewalker
modifiers.summary: Turns the ground under you to ice when it spots you.

modifiers.name: Lowered Expectations
modifiers.summary: Keeps turning patches of floor into blocks that pull you down.

modifiers.name: Magic Immune
modifiers.summary: Takes no magic damage.

modifiers.name: Magic Resistant
modifiers.summary: Takes 50% less magic damage.

modifiers.name: Physical Immune
modifiers.summary: Takes no physical damage.

modifiers.name: Physical Resistant
modifiers.summary: Takes 50% less physical damage.

modifiers.name: Reactive Distance Shielded
modifiers.summary: Hitting it from range debuffs you.

modifiers.name: Spore Carrier
modifiers.summary: Keeps spawning mushroom men that explode when they die. They vanish after 10 seconds and give no kill credit.

modifiers.name: The Floor is Lava
modifiers.summary: Keeps turning patches of floor to lava. Anyone caught loses health regen for 10 seconds.

modifiers.name: The Floor is Lava II
modifiers.summary: Keeps turning patches of floor to lava. Anyone caught loses health regen for 15 seconds.

modifiers.name: Trigger Finger
modifiers.summary: Every so often the boss turns reactive: hit it then and you're stunned.

modifiers.name: Turret Summoning
modifiers.summary: Summons a flamethrower turret when it spots you. It vanishes after 30 seconds and gives no kill credit.

modifiers.name: Vulnerable I
modifiers.summary: Incoming damage +15%.

modifiers.name: Vulnerable II
modifiers.summary: Incoming damage +30%.

modifiers.name: Vulnerable III
modifiers.summary: Incoming damage +45%.

modifiers.name: Water-Cursed
modifiers.summary: Creatures that die release a burst that refills flasks nearby.

pressure.name: Under Pressure
pressure.description:
Reduces your Health Regeneration.
This effect scales with your current Delve depth.

tier_effects.name: Death boon
lines: When a player dies, the rest of the party is healed to full

tier_effects.name: Death curse
lines: When a player dies, the rest of the party is hit by a death curse
